recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Decouple modulatory-channel routing (lateral_pfc/curiosity/gated_policy/mech295) from the e3_score_decomp_enabled diagnostic flag
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: In ree_core/agent.py, _bdc_lpfc/_bdc_gp/_bdc_m295/_bdc_curiosity are only assigned their computed bias when self.e3.e3_score_decomp_enabled is True (agent.py ~6194, 6530-6531, 6718-6719, 6909-6910, 6997-6998), and the modulatory_channel_route_source dispatch at ~7607-7635 reads those same _bdc_* variables to build channel_route_bias -- so four of six route-source values are silently no-op unless a script also sets the unrelated diagnostic flag. Fix: populate the four _bdc_* variables unconditionally (or at minimum whenever use_modulatory_channel_routing=True and modulatory_channel_route_source selects one of the four affected values), and gate only the diagnostic EXPOSURE (last_score_decomp / component trackers, the original V3-EXQ-571 purpose) behind e3_score_decomp_enabled. Add a runtime assertion/warning as a backstop for any remaining coupling. New contract test: modulatory_channel_route_source in {lateral_pfc, curiosity, gated_policy, mech295} with e3_score_decomp_enabled=False (the common case) should still produce a nonzero route_range when the underlying per-candidate bias is genuinely differentiated.

learning_extracted: A precondition/readiness gate that a later, simplified script drops can be exactly the gate that would have caught the real defect -- 851's C1g route-range readiness check self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue correctly; 859/863 dropped that check and could not self-catch the same defect.

Bit-identical arms across a manipulation are not self-evidently a clean null -- check whether the manipulation's own pre-outcome magnitude/range reads as genuinely zero, not just whether the two arms match each other.

A diagnostic-instrumentation flag (e3_score_decomp_enabled) can silently double as an undocumented functional precondition for unrelated substrate features -- a design smell worth a dedicated substrate fix.

A causal narrative restated across a chain of docstrings (851 -> 859 -> 863) drifted from the originating run's own more cautious self-assessment (851 self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue, not a confirmed collapse).

An autopsy's own read should be cross-checked against raw per-arm fields the interpretation grid didn't surface, especially when corroborating readings (criteria_non_degenerate, and a human concurrence with it) share the same blind spot rather than being independent.
